artifacts.content:
# Impact Planner Revision-6 Verification

Outcome: pass

## Context and package identity

All 29 declared repository context files matched their exact raw SHA-256 digests and byte counts before use. The eight predecessor SpecialistAgentHandoff files parsed with the required closed envelope, artifact, and evidence bindings. Their revision lineage and outcomes were coherent with `predecessor.json` and the revision-6 recovery goal.

The host package-verification receipt records a successful `verifySpecialistPackage` operation for compilation digest `sha256:4e0be7083c27a00fdf7daab7f77f8617023a6224f39bbd07c857773d2e093e30` and package digest `sha256:ecd43861a976c23b60f5d35da35b588a9299936209d8930481e196b6a73e6d7f`. It binds the 203184-byte package envelope with raw digest `sha256:798ac54cdd175b7e5557cf5b7a2cb72eb0a96daf7e6af94925713651f8a8282f` and the 2058-byte manifest with raw digest `sha256:f4958138c0578a85e16688004d24f84fc035e9df5441d4d8d5546e423f305f76`. The host repair receipt is bound as a 1100-byte runtime input with raw digest `sha256:581545b7bf713a33d540bc457fa7bdfaca8a3ad3809d0c24263313752c653cd0`; it does not alter package identity.

## Candidate inspection

The exact bound stylesheet places display, padding, `min-height: 2.75rem`, and pointer behavior on `.changed-item label`. The non-interactive `.changed-item` has no padding. The exact bound integration test asserts this corrected source-to-stylesheet contract.

## Automated verification

`npm.cmd test` passed 23 of 23 tests with zero failures, skips, or cancellations.

`npm.cmd run check` passed syntax checks for all seven declared files: `server.mjs`, `src/app.js`, `src/codec.js`, `src/graph.js`, `src/storage.js`, `src/ui-policy.js`, and `src/view.js`.

## Browser verification

The exact bound candidate was inspected at `http://localhost:4175/` in the in-app browser.

Desktop used a 1280x800 viewport override with a 1265px document client width. All four changed-component labels measured approximately 378.02px wide by exactly 44px high, with computed `min-height: 44px`. Checkbox glyphs measured 20px by 20px. A click six pixels inside the right label edge, outside the checkbox bounds, toggled Public API from unchecked to checked. Document horizontal overflow was zero.

Mobile used the required 390x844 viewport override with a 375px document client width. All four labels measured 304px wide by exactly 44px high, with computed `min-height: 44px`. Checkbox glyphs remained 20px by 20px. A click six pixels inside the right edge of the Operations Dashboard label, outside the checkbox bounds, toggled it from unchecked to checked. Document horizontal overflow was zero.

Console inspection after both viewport checks and interactions returned no warnings or errors. The viewport override was reset and browser tabs were finalized.

## Verdict

Pass. Package identity, context identity, predecessor handoffs, recovery lineage, corrected pointer-target ownership, complete automated verification, desktop and mobile target geometry, padding activation, responsive overflow, and console cleanliness are verified with no material finding.
